name: Create Technical Research
script:
from frappe.utils import to_markdown

technical_research = frappe.new_doc("Technical Research")
technical_research.title = doc.title
technical_research.assignee = doc.assignee_user
# description is a Text Editor (HTML); summary is Small Text (plain).
# Convert HTML to plain text, preserving paragraph/line/list formatting.
technical_research.summary = (to_markdown(doc.description) or "").strip() if doc.description else ""
technical_research.insert()
